spec.description: Nodes, resource groups, resources, networks and Cluster Shared Volumes of the failover cluster of one Windows host.

spec.expr: count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) == 0) or (0 * count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster nodes in state Up. Requires the mscluster collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Nodes up

spec.expr: count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) != 0) or (0 * count(max by (node) (windows_mscluster_node_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster nodes that are down, paused or joining. A paused node runs no new roles, for example during maintenance.
spec.title: Nodes not up

spec.expr: count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) >= 2 < 4) or (0 * count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})))

spec.description: Resource groups (cluster roles, for example VMs) that failed or are only partially online.
spec.title: Groups failed

spec.expr: count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) == 1) or (0 * count(max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})))

spec.description: Resource groups that are offline, for example stopped VMs. Offline is often intended.
spec.title: Groups offline

spec.expr: count(max by (resource, type, resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resource_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) == 4) or (0 * count(max by (resource, type, resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resource_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})))
count(max by (network) (windows_mscluster_network_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) != 3) or (0 * count(max by (network) (windows_mscluster_network_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})))

spec.description: Cluster networks that are unavailable, down or partitioned. A partitioned network has lost connectivity between some nodes.
spec.title: Networks not up

spec.description: Quorum type of the cluster: node majority, file share witness or disk (storage) witness.
spec.title: Quorum

spec.description: State, drain status, current vote, owned resource groups and build of each cluster node. Dynamic quorum removes the vote of some nodes to keep quorum when nodes fail.
spec.title: Nodes

spec.description: State of each cluster node over time.
spec.title: Node state

spec.description: Resource groups each node owns. Steps show failovers and live migrations; a node without groups runs no roles.
spec.title: Resource groups per node

spec.expr: max by (resource_group, node) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_owner_node{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} == 1) and on (resource_group) (max by (resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resourcegroup_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) != 0)

spec.description: Resource groups that are not online and the node that owns them. Offline groups of stopped VMs are listed too.
spec.title: Resource groups not online

spec.expr: max by (resource, node) (windows_mscluster_resource_owner_node{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} == 1) and on (resource) (max by (resource, type, resource_group) (windows_mscluster_resource_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) != 2)

spec.description: Cluster resources that are not online, with their type, resource group and owner node.
spec.title: Resources not online

spec.description: State, role and metric of each cluster network. The cluster prefers networks with a lower metric for cluster traffic.
spec.title: Networks

spec.expr: 1 - max by (shared_volume) (windows_mscluster_shared_volumes_free_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) / max by (shared_volume) (windows_mscluster_shared_volumes_total_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})

spec.description: Size, free space and used share of each Cluster Shared Volume. Requires the mscluster collector.
spec.title: Cluster Shared Volumes

spec.expr: 1 - max by (shared_volume) (windows_mscluster_shared_volumes_free_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) / max by (shared_volume) (windows_mscluster_shared_volumes_total_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})

spec.description: Used share of each Cluster Shared Volume. Thin provisioned virtual hard disks keep growing into the free space.
spec.title: Cluster Shared Volume usage
Windows Exporter / Failover Cluster
